reading: Every upstream marker found is one of the two comment lines `// Remove chars preceding ...` with the spelling corrected; the upstream change corrects it the same way, but its code differs (it adds the s flag; this run's patch uses [\s\S]*). The model's own edit wrote the corrected comments in its response at exchange 35; the first request the harness sent carrying them is exchange 39, a tool result and later repair briefs showing the workspace back. No request before exchange 35 carried any upstream, faulty or evaluator marker, and no planner request carried any.
verdict: no exposure: the markers are the model's own change echoed back
